description:
Let them explore their world in style! The Huffy eThunder Road Electric Bike features a throwback banana seat and high-rise handlebars for a retro vibe, paired with electric power to unlock a new level of fun and independence. It’s the perfect mix of classic design and modern performance for big kids and teens.
As a class 2 electric capabilities, riders can enjoy three levels of pedal assist or engage the throttle for an extra boost. Whether cruising uphill or speeding along a flat trail, the eThunder Road puts control in their hands.
The intuitive LCD display keeps you informed on every ride, showing speed, battery life, and assist mode. With all the details at your fingertips, staying in control has never been easier.
Equipped with a 24V battery, the eThunder Road offers hours of fun on a full charge. Charging is simple: securely lock the battery in place or remove it for convenient indoor charging while the bike stays outside. This flexibility ensures the bike is always ready for the next journey.
With a 250W rear hub motor and responsive disc brakes, the Huffy eThunder Road delivers smooth, reliable power and confident stopping. Whether speeding up or slowing down, this bike keeps riders in control at every turn.
